dedupe_keys.name: lateral performance behavior of large scale pile specimens with different structural bending properties in loose granular soil

description: Lateral Performance Behavior of Large Scale Pile Specimens with Different Structural Bending Properties in Loose Granular Soil is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Anne Lemnitzer, University of California Irvine (uci.edu). The dataset here presented was generated during an investigation of the lateral load behavior of deep foundation elements in loose, granular soil. Three large-scale, structurally distinct pile specimens were tested at the Structural Engineering Laboratory at UC Irvine in California. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Pile tests, Large-scale experiments, Lateral loading, pile stiffness, p-y curves, sand. Published 2026-07-02. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
